tagline: Sprint and issue lookups for remote teammates — writes need your approval.
requirements: Set ATLASSIAN_SITE_NAME (for your-company.atlassian.net use your-company), ATLASSIAN_USER_EMAIL, and ATLASSIAN_API_TOKEN in the host environment. Jira Cloud only. Atlassian's own MCP server is remote-only, so this entry uses a well-maintained community stdio server.

tools.name: jira_get
tools.note: Reads any Jira REST endpoint the token can access, including issues, comments, and user data. Scope the API token to the projects you intend to share.

tools.name: jira_post
tools.note: Creates issues, comments, and other resources.

tools.name: jira_put
tools.note: Replaces issues, comments, and other resources.

seo.description: Share Jira MCP tools with MCPWire. Configure an Atlassian API token on the host, read issues and projects over P2P, and keep create, update, and delete tools out of the allowlist.
